summaryFa: چوب در گیره ثابت است و آدمک بنفش مغار را رو به بیرون می‌راند؛ جای بدن، دست‌ها و براده، جهت درست برش را نشان می‌دهند.
storyFa: روی میز کار چوبی، قطعه‌ای چوب محکم در گیره قرار گرفته است. آدمک بنفش پشت دستهٔ مغار ایستاده و آن را از سمت خودش به سوی سرِ آزاد چوب می‌راند. برادهٔ تازه مثل روبانی پیچ خورده و یک قاشق چوبی آماده در گوشهٔ میز، مقصد کار را مشخص می‌کند.
meaningFa: برای کار با ابزار تیز، قطعه را ثابت کن و ابزار را از بدن و دست‌هایت دور ببر؛ دقت در جهت حرکت از عجله مهم‌تر است.
sentenceEn: With sharp things, always cut away from yourself.
sentenceFa: با هر وسیله‌ی تیزی که می‌بُری، جهت برش رو از خودت دور بگیر.
revisionSummaryFa: ضخامت بازوها و تنهٔ آدمک بنفش کم و متعادل شده و رنگ‌گذاری بدن با شست‌وشوهای روشن‌تر و لایه‌های بنفش بازبینی شده است. صحنهٔ نجاری، پیش‌بند، گیره، جهت مغار و نوشته محفوظ‌اند.
userFeedbackFa: فرم بدن و رنگ آمیزی آدمک بنفش با الگوهای من فرق داره.... متفاوته. چاقه.... اما بقیه تصویر خوبه
fullGenerationPromptEnglish:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: a finished, square, print-quality narrative illustration for a Persian visual book of Kevin Kelly's advice.
Source sentence: "With sharp things, always cut away from yourself."
Interpret the sentence as a concrete everyday direction-of-cut safety habit. Do not turn it into a philosophical metaphor. The blade's travel AWAY from the cutter's body must be the instantly readable main idea, readable by a twelve-year-old without any external explanation.

ESTABLISHED BOOK CHARACTER AND PAINTING STYLE:
True hand-painted transparent watercolor on visible fine cold-press paper. Build the characters themselves out of overlapping translucent pigment washes: softly varied patches of light and medium color, gentle wet-on-dry edges, occasional restrained pigment gathering along an edge, darker watercolor shading under the perfectly circular head where head meets shoulders. Layered watercolor should also appear in the objects, floor, and quiet background. Soft natural white outer margins, an irregular yet controlled painted scene boundary fading into white paper; never flood paint to the image file edge. This is an attractive published-book painting, not a flat vector diagram, not marker, wax crayon, colored pencil, plastic, glossy 3D, airbrushed gradients or computer cel shading.
Simple adult humanoids in the approved book's family: a perfectly circular head (same width and height in its visible frontal plane, never egg-shaped), balanced moderate adult body with comfortably long legs and arms, a simple straight neutral torso and moderate rather than inflated arm thickness; no puffy upper arms, ballooned forearms, chunky mitten hands or protruding barrel abdomen. Do not make the figure skeletal, excessively thin or noodle-like. No neck. Smooth gender-neutral torso with no breasts, cleavage, narrow waist, wide hips or buttock emphasis; all genders share the same body silhouette. No hair. Where a female character is specified, indicate it only with two short delicate eyelashes attached to the SAME small oval eye design; do not change the eyes into makeup eyes. Eyes are tiny friendly dark ovals with optionally one tiny white highlight dot, NO white eyeball/sclera and NO prominent oversized pupils. Simple expressive curved eyebrows and mouth. No hard circular pink cheek stamps. Outlines are thin painted darker local body color, never a black character contour. Each visible hand has exactly THREE fingers plus ONE thumb, four digits total, with simple elegant shapes, not a mitten, not five digits. No clothing except a specified functional apron; no anatomical nudity details, completely family friendly.

STORYTELLING:
One uncluttered situation, one visible cutting action, modest adult-friendly humor through a small situational detail. Both the hand controlling the tool and the other hand stay BEHIND or safely to the SIDE of the blade's advancing direction. Nobody, no pet and no limb stands in front of the blade. No injuries, blood, threat, weapons or self-harm. A single short painted curved arrow beside the tool, parallel to the actual cut line, may clarify the direction from the cutter's side outward. Its arrowhead must point away from the torso, never toward the body or toward the other hand. Do not use conflicting arrows.
Only necessary Persian in-image text. No English text, no Latin letters, no numbers, no watermark, no title of the source sentence. Put the short Persian label "دور از خودت" near the outward arrow, legibly in authentic connected Persian lettering. Integrate that one label gently into the painting, not an infographic banner. Allow generous breathing room around it.
Show all hands, feet, objects and tool fully inside the scene, with comfortable margins; no cropped limbs. Keep faces kind and attentive, not frightening.

SCENE B — CARVING A WOODEN SPOON:
A small friendly adult woodcraft workshop with one sturdy pale wooden workbench, a single clamp and almost no background decoration. The character is lavender-purple, with gender-neutral adult proportions and only a simple ochre apron. It stands on the LEFT of the bench, body clearly to the LEFT of the active cutting area. A narrow wooden spoon blank lies horizontally on the workbench, fixed firmly in a small wooden clamp at the LEFT end, with its working end extending toward the RIGHT away from the character. Use a high three-quarter side view to expose the geometry: body on the left, two hands gripping a wooden-handled broad carving gouge from BEHIND its cutting edge, edge advancing toward the right along the wood. Both hands remain together behind the edge, never ahead of it. The gouge is pushed RIGHT, away from torso, into the wood surface, making one thin curling pale wood shaving that rolls outward like a harmless ribbon. A small painted arrow parallel to the shaving and cutting direction points RIGHT, away from the character; the Persian "دور از خودت" sits next to it. An already finished simple wooden spoon rests at the very back corner of the bench, away from the cutting zone; it explains the purpose of the work without clutter. The character has a small pleased focused smile, a perfectly circular head and friendly small dark oval eyes, no white eyeballs. Show full body and feet, complete bench legs, and the clamp holding wood securely. Make the gouge unmistakably a woodworking tool cutting wood, no weapon. No mallet, no extra blades. The charming long curl of wood is the only visual joke.

FINAL CHARACTER CONSTRUCTION AND PAINTING:
The lavender-purple craftsman has balanced adult proportions, a direct join between the perfectly circular head and upper shoulders, and a subdued local-purple contact shadow below the head. The shoulders, upper arms, forearms and hands are moderate in thickness; the straight neutral torso is naturally aligned with both complete legs underneath the functional cream-ochre apron. Its small dark oval eyes retain tiny interior light reflections but have no surrounding white sclera. Face looks down attentively toward the cutting action with a small kind closed smile.
Paint the purple head and entire body with luminous, diluted lavender watercolor washes and overlapping medium-lilac patches, with soft irregular boundaries and restrained darker purple pigment around the lower edges. Broader lighter washes vary with richer lavender areas, while subtle paper grain remains visible. The thin painted outline is darker violet from the body's own color family. Preserve fine edges around hands and the gouge so the hand grip and cutting direction remain clear. Avoid flat marker filling, dense uniform artificial grain, crumpled-paper pattern, black outlines, glossy plastic or polished 3D lighting.
The square composition includes the craftsman's whole body and both feet at left, a large workbench filling the right and foreground, a wall window behind the figure, restrained warm workshop shelves and upright planks. The workpiece remains clamped securely; the carving gouge travels rightward away from torso, both hands behind its edge, and the pale curl and nearby arrow show that same outward travel. The exact connected Persian label is "دور از خودت". No English lettering or additional text appears. Keep warm restrained watercolor throughout the room, white paper margins and all important objects inside the painting.

qa.notesFa: نسخهٔ واقعی بررسی شد: بازوها و تنه از نسخهٔ قبلی باریک‌تر اما میانه‌اند؛ بدن خنثی و چشم بی‌سفیدی حفظ شده است. مغار و هر دو دست پشت لبه، چوب در گیره، فلش و عبارت فارسی و هر دو پا محفوظ‌اند. رنگ‌گذاری بنفش روشن‌تر و دارای نواحی شست‌وشوی پهن‌تر شده؛ مقداری ریزبافت اولیه هنوز دیده می‌شود و تطابق کامل قطعی با سلیقهٔ کاربر ادعا نمی‌شود.
